server._comment_host: Host/IP used by commander listen socket.
server._comment_port: Port used by commander to receive soldier reports.
server._comment_max_line_bytes: Maximum accepted request line size in bytes.
server._comment_recv_chunk_bytes: Socket recv chunk size for incremental line reads.
server._comment_listen_backlog: TCP listen backlog for commander server socket.

_comment_scanner: Task scanning settings for commander background loop.

scanner._comment_data_dir: Directory that stores daily unified task files; relative to commander/ when not absolute.
scanner._comment_scan_interval_seconds: Interval between scan cycles in seconds.

_comment_storage: Repository file lock and text storage limits.

storage._comment_lock_timeout_seconds: Timeout for task file lock acquisition in seconds.
storage._comment_max_store_text: Maximum stdout/stderr characters persisted per task report.

dispatch._comment_soldier_timeout_seconds: TCP connect/send timeout when dispatching to soldier.
dispatch._comment_client_timeout_seconds: Subprocess timeout when commander invokes dispatch.py.
dispatch._comment_timeout_minutes: Expiry timeout in minutes written into dispatched waiting tasks.

_comment_generator: Role task generation quality, retry settings, and DeepSeek API configuration.

generator._comment_min_tasks_per_role: Minimum number of tasks required per role.
generator._comment_max_tasks_per_role: Maximum number of tasks allowed per role.
generator._comment_min_non_five_ratio: Minimum ratio of tasks whose minute is not 00/05/.../55.
generator._comment_api_base_url: DeepSeek API base URL. '/chat/completions' will be appended automatically when needed.
generator._comment_api_key: DeepSeek API key used for task generation.
generator._comment_model: DeepSeek model used for task generation.
generator._comment_request_timeout_seconds: Timeout for each DeepSeek API request in seconds.
generator._comment_max_tokens: Maximum completion tokens requested from DeepSeek for each role-generation call.

_comment_paths: Project-relative paths resolved against commander/ directory.

paths._comment_logs_dir: Log directory for commander and dispatch logs.
paths._comment_target_ini_file: Role target mapping INI used by commander and dispatch.
paths._comment_dispatch_script: Dispatch script path invoked by commander scanner.
paths._comment_domain_resource_file: Domain resource markdown file used for prompt generation.

logging._comment_level: Root logger level name (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).
logging._comment_backup_count: Number of rotated daily log files to keep.
logging._comment_rotation_interval_days: Rotation interval in days for TimedRotatingFileHandler.
